questions.stem_text: Which of the following would reduce economic growth?

options.A: An increase in immigration from abroad.
options.B: A rise in the level of education.
options.C: A rise in the literacy rate.
options.E: A growth in the number of small businesses.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - An increase in immigration from abroad.

questions.stem_text: Which of the following increases the size of the tax multiplier?

options.A: An increase in the reserve ratio.
options.B: An increase in the money supply.
options.C: A decrease in the marginal propensity to consume.
options.D: A decrease in the spending multiplier.
options.E: An increase in the interest rate.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - An increase in the reserve ratio.
